title: Tondai Nadu 261-270

CHE1.t: Mamallapuram: Pallava Shore Temple, Pancha Rathas, Arjuna's Penance (UNESCO)

CHE2.t: Second India-China informal summit, Modi and Xi at Mamallapuram, October 2019

CHE4.t: 2023 hooch deaths in Chengalpattu and Villupuram districts (Maduranthakam, Marakkanam)

CHN1.t: Krishna water from Andhra Pradesh reaches Chennai through the Telugu Ganga project (inter-State agreement, 1983)

CHN2.t: Justice C.S. Karnan, Madras High Court judge 2009-2016: walked into another court room during a PIL hearing to complain; first sitting HC judge jailed for contempt (2017)

CHN3.t: 2019 water crisis: four reservoirs dry, water brought by train from Jolarpettai

CHN4.t: Fort St George: seat of the Tamil Nadu Government Secretariat

TVL1.t: Krishna water enters Tamil Nadu at Zero Point, Uthukottai, and is stored in Poondi reservoir

VEL1.t: Vellore Mutiny, 10 July 1806: first large sepoy mutiny; sepoys rose to free Tipu Sultan's sons confined in the fort

VEL2.t: Vellore Fort held Tipu Sultan's family and the last king of Sri Lanka as prisoners

VEL3.t: Vellore Citizens Welfare Forum v. Union of India (1996): tannery effluent polluted the Palar; polluter pays and precautionary principle

VEL4.t: Rajiv case convict Nalini, India's longest serving woman prisoner, released from Vellore prison in Nov 2022 after the SC ordered premature release

TPT1.t: Jolarpettai water train carried Cauvery water to Chennai in 2019

TPT2.t: Ambur and Vaniyambadi tannery belt, part of the Palar pollution litigation

TVM1.t: Arunachaleswarar temple, Karthigai Deepam on the hill, Ramana Maharshi (general knowledge, not checked)

KLK1.t: June 2024 hooch tragedy, at least 65 dead; Collector transferred, SP and nine police suspended

KLK2.t: July 2022 Kaniyamoor school riot after a student's death

VPM1.t: Gingee Fort: Mughal siege 1690-1698, the longest in Mughal history; Rajaram held out inside

VPM2.t: Rajaram escaped before Gingee fell; the Shirke family hid him in the Mughal camp itself

VPM3.t: Secret understanding between Rajaram and the Mughal commander Zulfiqar Khan; safe passage given (blog source)

VPM4.t: Raja Desingh of Gingee refused to pay tax to the Nawab of Arcot; killed in war, 1714

VPM5.t: Auroville: township mostly in Tamil Nadu, with some parts in Puducherry

KPM1.t: Kanchipuram silk sarees (general knowledge, not checked)

KPM2.t: Sankararaman murder case: Kanchi seers charged on 14 counts in 2006

KPM3.t: Sankararaman trial: 189 witnesses examined, 83 hostile; all accused acquitted by a Puducherry court, 2013

KPM4.t: Sriperumbudur: Rajiv Gandhi killed by LTTE suicide bomber Dhanu, who approached as an admirer, 21 May 1991

KPM5.t: Sriperumbudur car and electronics factory belt (general knowledge, not checked)

RPT1.t: Ranipet ('queen's town') was built by Nawab Sadatullah Khan in honour of Raja Desingh's widow

RPT2.t: Raja Desingh refused to pay the tributary tax; Nawab waged war, 1714

RPT3.t: TCCL chromium waste on open land contaminating groundwater around Ranipet SIPCOT
